summary:
ASML最新季度營收與每股盈餘雙雙優於預期，受惠於強勁的半導體設備需求與AI相關技術投資。
• 每股盈餘(EPS)達7.58美元，優於市場預期的6.95美元。
• 季度總營收達93.3億美元，較去年同期成長21.25%。
• 受惠於人工智慧相關先進製程與設備的持續需求。
• 毛利率與獲利能力保持穩健。
ai_view:
觀點：財報數據展現強勁成長動能，釋出基本面穩健訊號。短中期對股價具正面支撐，但高估值下仍需密切追蹤下一季訂單能見度與毛利率變化。

需留意：高本益比(57.63倍)可能面臨估值修正壓力。；全球總體經濟不確定性與地緣政治對半導體供應鏈的潛在影響。

summary_en:
ASML reported better-than-expected quarterly revenue and EPS, driven by robust semiconductor equipment demand and AI-related investments.
• EPS came in at $7.58, beating the estimated $6.95.
• Quarterly revenue reached $9.33B, representing a 21.25% year-over-year increase.
• Benefited from sustained demand for AI-related advanced nodes and equipment.
• Gross margins and profitability remained resilient.

ai_view_en:
View: The earnings report demonstrates strong growth momentum, signaling solid fundamentals. It provides positive near- to mid-term price support, though the high valuation warrants close monitoring of next-quarter book-to-bill ratios and gross margins.

Watch：High trailing P/E ratio of 57.63 introduces valuation correction risks.; Global macroeconomic uncertainties and geopolitical impacts on the semiconductor supply chain.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，每股盈餘7.58美元高於預估的6.95美元，營收達93.3億美元。
